gen-flavors-mulish: Chunky and cheeky, with diagonals as hefty as the stems. Flavors grabs the attention, while Mulish, a sans-serif with no stroke modulation at all, keeps its horseshoe-open curves friendly underneath.
gen-gf-saira-extra-condensed-fs-erode: Saira Extra Condensed crowds its letters close together, with wire-straight strokes that never vary in thickness. And Erode, a serif with a gentle ebb and flow of weight, lets paragraphs unspool comfortably.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega reads like one nib drew it, with lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals. And Unica One does the loud work, its big-eyed curves full of daylight, while Lexend Mega handles the steady talking.
gen-gf-tektur-roboto-slab: Wiry and a bit wild, Tektur leaves generous terminal openings on every curve it draws. Roboto Slab then steadies things, a slab-serif whose dominant middle zone and open throats read smoothly line after line.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-bitter: Bitter is a grounded slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye and a see-through gap in every s. Above it, Tilt Neon's tube-like constant-width line is the real standout.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-lexend-tera: Storybook and wistful, Mystery Quest leaves open jaws on every curve. Lexend Tera spaces its letters like stepping stones, doing the quiet work while the heading carries the charm.
gen-righteous-gf-montserrat-alternates: Fun and loud, Righteous packs bowls that fill the line, like thin steel rod bent into every letter. Montserrat Alternates glides through paragraphs, its c open like a bent paperclip.
gen-fs-chubbo-fs-recia: Marker-tip friendly, Chubbo glides around every bend without a snag. Recia, a serif with only a faint modulation and generous openings at every weight, carries long reading with a crisp, authoritative hand.
gen-gf-offside-rubik: Expressive and widely tracked, Offside leaves its curves open and keeps one level beat with no accents of weight. Rubik's big, soft lowercase gives that stance a friendly landing.
gen-gf-revalia-rubik: Revalia stretches out with a relaxed stride and an open-tailed g. Rubik, big in the lowercase and soft in the round letters, gives that wide-set display a tidy, readable counterweight.
